name: Hapa Continuous Sharpening Loop
source: Hapa Worldbuilding Wiki — Continuous Sharpening Loop
operatingStance: Use what serves the objective. Drop what does not. Add lived context, Hapa priorities, downstream benefit, and new relationships back into the system.

stages.label: Human-agent turns
stages.purpose: Capture intent, response, and reusable work context.

stages.label: Second Brain retrieval
stages.purpose: Join turns with items, chunks, wiki maps, knowledge bodies, skills, and Hapa artifact evidence.

stages.label: Skill formation
stages.purpose: Promote recurring applied patterns into evidence-backed skills and connected capabilities.

stages.label: Hapa nodes and apps
stages.purpose: Express reusable skill through focused products, contracts, interfaces, and operator surfaces.

stages.label: Leverage
stages.purpose: Reuse cards, modules, evidence, and prior decisions so the next work starts further ahead.

stages.label: Sharpening ledger
stages.purpose: Record fit, benefit, continuing benefit, improvements, artifacts, and new connections for the next cycle.

guardrails: A query must carry purpose and objective.
Usefulness requires feedback; do not silently pile on open runs.
Derived links support navigation but do not prove deployment, adoption, or savings.
Humans retain approval over publication, sensitive data, and irreversible actions.
